title: Image Classifier
text: Classify data using a trained deep learning neural network, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Class names workspace variable} sets Workspace variable containing class names of the network output; {Network}, {File path} sets the mAT file containing trained network, {MATLAB function}, {Mini-batch size} sets the size of mini-batches, {Resize input}, {Classification} sets the output predicted label with highest score and {Predictions} sets the output all scores and associated labels. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: image
ports.summary: Image or feature data numeric array

ports.name: labels
ports.summary: Class labels for predicted scores matrix

params.name: Network
params.values: Source for trained network Network from MAT file (default) | Network from MATLAB function

params.name: File path
params.values: MAT file containing trained network untitled.mat (default) | MAT file path or name

params.name: MATLAB function
params.values: MATLAB function name squeezenet (default) | MATLAB function name

params.name: Classification
params.values: Output predicted label with highest score on (default) | off

params.name: Predictions
params.values: Output all scores and associated labels off (default) | on

params.name: Class names workspace variable
params.values: Workspace variable containing class names of the network output classNames (default) | categorical vector variable | string array variable | cell array of character vectors variable name
